title: Latest tokens bought in the market are more expensive than in the pool
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The price of the tokens bought in the market increases as the number of `tokensSold` approaches `tradeableSupply`. This means that the last tokens bought in the market are ~1% more expensive than the first tokens bought in the pool.
